source.note: Search summaries: 275 km of slopes including 29 km of ski routes (easy 115 km/42%, medium 121 km/44%, difficult 10 km/4%, ski routes 29 km/11%) and 81 lifts with a total capacity of 146,520 persons/hour (SkiWelt facts, e.g. https://www.ellmau-going.at/en/winter/the-skiwelt/facts/the-skiwelt/). Lift types per skiresort.info: 16 gondolas, 32 chairlifts, 13 T-bar/platter lifts (61 of 81 typed; the rest were not typed). Another summary gave 17 gondolas, 8 chairlifts, 34 T-bars and 3 conveyors (see conflicts).
Piste reference data — confirm at source. Only features Piste is confident about are set; everything else is unknown (null), not 'not offered'. Ski schools and rental shops operate at the bases

character: One of Austria's largest linked ski areas, spanning nine villages in the Wilder Kaiser and Brixental valleys of Tyrol on one ticket. The terrain is mostly easy and intermediate at modest altitude (about 620–1,870 m), with the Hohe Salve as its best-known summit.
learning: Search summary: 42% of the slopes are rated easy. Reference note: every village has ski schools and nursery areas; confirm lesson products.

source.note: Official skiwelt.at homepage: 'Skiing from 5 December 2026'. Austria Tourism newsroom 'Winter is Coming: Ski Opening Dates in Austria' (8 Sept 2026): 'SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser Brixental 5 December 2026 – 4 April 2027' ('Weather and snow conditions can shift dates at short notice').
